# Ratamatap

Offline Android snare-rudiment practice app; currently an M0 Compose skeleton.

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): build, validation, dependency and signing rules.
- [Decisions](DECISIONS.md): product and architecture authority.
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): ordered milestones and exit criteria.
- [Development](docs/development.md): Android SDK, Gradle and device commands.
- [Tooling](docs/tooling.md): pins and AGP built-in Kotlin.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): versioning and release pipeline.
- [Beta builds](docs/beta-builds.md): separate beta identity and installation.
- [Secrets](docs/secrets.md): signing credentials and boundaries.
- [Supply chain](docs/supply-chain.md): Renovate and Gradle integrity.
- [GitHub workflows](docs/github-workflows.md): checks and automation.
- [Manifest](MANIFEST.md): historical devkit inventory, not current files.
